text:
Copper(II) oxide reacts with iron. The equation for the reaction is shown.
3CuO  +  2Fe  →  3Cu  +  Fe2O3
Why can this reaction be described as the reduction of copper(II) oxide?
A
Iron gains oxygen.
The copper(II) oxide loses oxygen.
B
C
The copper(II) oxide weighs less after the reaction than before.
D
There are fewer substances on the right of the equation.

options.label: C
options.text: The copper(II) oxide weighs less after the reaction than before.

options.label: D
options.text: There are fewer substances on the right of the equation.
